name: SmartSaver Account
description: A tiered savings product with interest rates varying by balance range. Rates are published in the live interest rate schedule and apply through the end of each calendar month. Interest accrues daily and is paid monthly to opted-in customers.
context: Interest accrues daily and is paid monthly
Opted-in customers received email and SMS notification

name: SmartSaver Plus Account
description: A premium savings product variant offering a fixed AER rate of 5.15%. Rates apply only through 2026-02-28.

name: SmartSaver Account Tier 1 Rate
description: The interest rate tier for SmartSaver Account balances from £0 to £10,000. Rate is 4.40% AER, effective 2026-02-01, with daily accrual and monthly payment.
context: Interest accrues daily and is paid monthly

name: SmartSaver Account Tier 2 Rate
description: The interest rate tier for SmartSaver Account balances from £10,001 to £50,000. Rate is 4.60% AER, effective 2026-02-01, with daily accrual and monthly payment.
context: Interest accrues daily and is paid monthly

name: SmartSaver Account Tier 3 Rate
description: The interest rate tier for SmartSaver Account balances of £50,001 and above. Rate is 4.70% AER, effective 2026-02-01, with daily accrual and monthly payment.
context: Interest accrues daily and is paid monthly

name: SmartSaver Plus Account Rate
description: The fixed interest rate for SmartSaver Plus Account. Rate is 5.15% AER, effective 2026-02-01 through 2026-02-28.

name: Opted-in Customer
description: Customers who have opted in to receive notifications about interest rate changes and account activity. These customers received email and SMS notification regarding the February 2026 rate schedule.
context: Opted-in customers received email and SMS notification

name: Email Notification
description: Email notification channel used to inform opted-in customers of interest rate changes and account updates for SmartSaver products.
context: Opted-in customers received email and SMS notification

name: SMS Notification
description: SMS notification channel used to inform opted-in customers of interest rate changes and account updates for SmartSaver products.
context: Opted-in customers received email and SMS notification
